patch_proposals.suggested_text:
## 18. Summary

Crust Chant should validate demand, contribution, capacity, and workload before expanding.

## Appendix A. Complete Channel-Mix Sensitivity

### Scenario indicators

| **Indicator** | **35,000 THB salary, 40/60 mix** | **35,000 THB salary, 50/50 mix** | **50,000 THB salary, 40/60 mix** | **50,000 THB salary, 50/50 mix** |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Weighted contribution per sale unit | 75 THB | 85.50 THB | 75 THB | 85.50 THB |
| Monthly cost to cover with `E = 7,054 THB` and `T = 0` | 46,997 THB | 46,997 THB | 61,997 THB | 61,997 THB |
| Required total sale units per month | 627 | 550 | 827 | 726 |
| Required total sale units per week | 145 | 127 | 191 | 168 |
| Required retail / wholesale units per month | 251 / 376 | 275 / 275 | 331 / 496 | 363 / 363 |
| Provisional production commitment | 2 cycles, about 4 production days/week | 2 cycles, about 4 production days/week | 3 cycles, about 6 production days/week | 3 cycles, about 6 production days/week |
| Committed weekly capacity used for comparison | 140–160 loaves | 140–160 loaves | 210–240 loaves | 210–240 loaves |
| Capacity headroom against modeled weekly units | **5-unit shortfall** at 140; 15-unit buffer at 160 | 13–33-unit buffer | 19–49-unit buffer | 42–72-unit buffer |
| Contribution from 100 additional monthly units | 7,500 THB | 8,550 THB | 7,500 THB | 8,550 THB |

Here, `E` is gross monthly equipment rent and `T` is Thai-employee compensation not already included in verified product or channel unit costs. Setting `E` to 7,054 THB and `T` to zero is only a comparison case, not a conclusion that the final values will equal those amounts. Capacity comparisons provisionally treat one modeled sale unit as one loaf requiring similar refrigeration space.
